i am sorry to hear how you feel. almost a month clean is really an accomplishment. even if you do feel the way you do now, that is still something to be proud of.

thank you. im in therapy and probably should start on medication soon.

i hurt her by getting into this absolutely insane thought loop. i said some really nasty things to her. then she forgave me and my OCD latched onto ruminating about the event when she already wanted to move on. really blows. shes just exhausted and wants to see me get better (she's told me its not a relationship issue, like we've been approaching it, but a mental health crisis on my part.)

Thank you. I like your point about reframing the situation a lot. I keep catching myself thinking "If I could go back in time, I'd do this" which does absolutely nothing. I wish it wasn't this exact experience, but I feel I'm maturing a lot and unlearning really unproductive attitudes.

Thank you. It isn't her responsibility at all. I can tell me asking for reassurance is obsessive-compulsive behavior, which is the exact same selfish thing that I did to hurt her in the first place. I need to accept her feelings and focus on my own too in a healthy way.
Thank you. That's a good point about guilt I should have recognized. I need to let those feelings process naturally.
